verdict.rationale: The evidence never addresses AI-model training directly. Its local-first, end-to-end-encrypted design implies vendor-side training is structurally unlikely: anonymous use with no registration, items not stored on third-party servers, sync only to the user's own iCloud/Google Drive, self-hosting, and 'no telemetry' for 2FAS Auth. This is architectural protection rather than a documented guarantee or user control. Missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training policy statement, any opt-out or control for training use, no-telemetry confirmation covering 2FAS Pass, and independent verification.
